description: This Java source file defines an abstract class CommandConsumer that wraps around an AMQP receiver link for consuming commands, including methods for creating tracing spans and logging command information.

classes.name: CommandConsumer
classes.description: An abstract class that manages AMQP command reception and tracing.

methods.name: createSpan
methods.description: Creates and starts an OpenTracing span for a command consumer operation, tagging it with tenant, device, and optionally gateway IDs.

methods.name: logReceivedCommandToSpan
methods.description: Logs details of a received command message to the provided tracing span, or logs an error if the command is invalid.
